book.title: Book a shoot
book.intro: Tell us the car, the date and the road. We reply the same day.
book.message: Hello Wyndle, I'd like to book a shoot. The car:

steps.heading: Tell us about the car
steps.body: Make, colour, and anything we should know: a fresh detail, a wrap, a plate you'd like hidden.

steps.heading: We choose the road and the time
steps.body: We pick a stretch with you and set the start by the sun on the day.

steps.heading: We confirm by message
steps.body: The time, the meeting point and what to bring. If the weather turns, we move the date.

shotList.title: Plan the shots
shotList.intro: Pick what matters on your car. The list comes to us before the day.

turnaround.note: Working days, not counting bank holidays. An estimate; we confirm it when we book.

listingSet.title: The listing set
listingSet.intro: The same twelve photographs for every car, in the same light, so a forecourt reads as one.

questions.q: How far ahead should I book?
questions.a: Two to three weeks for a weekday, longer for weekends in summer.
We move the date, at no charge, as long as we decide by midday on the day.

questions.q: How long does a shoot take?
questions.a: Two hours for The drive, about three for The evening. A dealer day is a full day.

questions.q: Do I need to clean the car first?
questions.a: Yes, and the cleaner the better: paint shows everything in low light.

questions.q: Can you hide my number plate?
questions.a: Yes. We blur it in every photograph and film. Just say when you book.
Only where the rules and the place allow it, and only in calm weather, so we never promise it.

questions.q: Can I post the film with music?
questions.a: Yes. We use licensed music, cleared for social media.

questions.q: Can our dealership use the work in ads?
questions.a: Tell us where it will run and we'll include that use in the quote.

questions.q: How soon do I get it?
questions.a: Photographs in five working days, films in ten. Pick a date on the packages page to see yours.
